metadata.title: Email Notification Gateway Pattern
metadata.remarks: Defines the architectural capability for system-generated, outbound-only email notifications delivered exclusively to institution-owned email domains. This pattern represents stable architectural intent for internal operational notifications and is distinct from collaboration relays and regulated bulk messaging.

components.title: Internal Email Notification Mediation
components.description: Provides a controlled mechanism for applications and systems to deliver non-interactive, outbound email notifications into institutional email services using managed system identities.

links.text: Supports Communications Management (BC220) business capability in the Business Reference Model (BRM).
Uses Email (TC048) transport in the Technology Reference Model (TRM).
Handles Communications and Correspondence (DE188) data entity in the Data Reference Model (DRM).

implemented-requirements.remarks: Notification gateways must use managed, non-interactive identities to ensure attribution and accountability for system-generated email.
Notification gateway activity must be auditable to support accountability, investigation, and operational monitoring.

components.remarks: This pattern is limited to internal, operational notifications addressed to institution-owned domains. It does not support marketing, broadcast messaging, external recipients, opt-out handling, or consent tracking, all of which are defined exclusively by the Email Bulk Messaging Gateway pattern.
